sub_questions: What is the authoritative 2025-26 India sugar production figure, and why do published estimates range 28.3-34.9 MMT (ISMA vs AISTA vs NFCSF vs government), gross vs net-of-ethanol?

What is Bikaji Foods' actual edible-oil / raw-material cost inflation, verified against a primary source (investor presentation, earnings-call transcript, or annual report), reconciling the conflicting 12-14% vs 63% figures?
What is the precise edible-oil import-duty timeline (the May 2025 cut and the reportedly January 2026 increase) as documented by primary PIB press releases and CBIC customs tariff notifications?
Is there any hard mithai/sweets-specific sales-VOLUME (unit) data following the 2025/2026 price hikes, as opposed to spend-intent survey data?
What are the current 2026 RBI reference rate (INR/USD) and ICE Brent crude levels, verified against RBI and ICE primary data (testing the secondary figures INR 94-97/USD and Brent $111-121)?
What is the combined effect of the sugar shock and the edible-oil cost run-up on the gross margins of festival-goods manufacturers (mithai, snacks, packaged confectionery) ahead of Diwali 2026?

How does cost pass-through / absorption capacity differ between organized branded manufacturers and unorganized mithai/halwai makers, and what levers (MRP hikes, grammage/shrinkflation, hedged procurement, GST 2.0) explain the asymmetry?
What is the status of the India-US trade deal soybean-oil tariff / TRQ provisions as a potential margin-relief wildcard?

time_periods.primary_source: ISMA/AISTA/NFCSF production releases and DFPD/ISO balance sheets for the 2025-26 season
Bikaji Foods investor presentation and earnings-call transcript for the quarters ended Jun 30 2025 and Sep 30 2025
PIB release and CBIC customs notification cutting edible-oil import duty (20%->10%)
PIB release and CBIC customs notification reportedly raising crude/refined edible-oil duty
RBI reference rate archive (INR/USD) and ICE Brent settlement data for 2026

scope_conditions: India specifically (not global sugar/oilseed markets except as drivers)
festival-goods manufacturers: mithai, snacks, packaged confectionery (not staple foods broadly)
primary/official sources take precedence over secondary Indian business press
must be comparable and gap-filling versus Bot 1 evidence pack, not duplicative

levers.domain_notes: Primary/official documents FIRST and as the tie-breaker: PIB press releases, CBIC customs tariff notifications (notification number + effective date), RBI reference-rate archive, ICE Brent settlement, ISMA/AISTA/NFCSF production releases, DFPD balance sheets, ISO quarterly reports, and company investor presentations / earnings-call transcripts / annual reports (BSE/NSE filings). The core deliverable is figure RECONCILIATION, so always capture the estimating body, the exact figure, whether it is gross or net-of-ethanol, and the estimate date. Recency window is strict: sugar figures must be SS 2025-26; rate/crude figures must be 2026 calendar. Measured/official figures outrank aggregator or secondary-press numbers; when only secondary press is available, flag it as unverified. Indian business-press domains (Business Standard, CNBC-TV18, ThePrint, Tribune, Goodreturns) are frequently egress-blocked, so chase the primary source the article cites rather than the article. Where a figure cannot be resolved to a primary source, say so explicitly rather than picking one.

rationale.register: query is explicitly evaluation/resolution-shaped ('resolve the authoritative figure', 'primary-source verification', 'verify') plus a forward margin forecast
rationale.inference_depth: the load-bearing numbers live in primary filings, customs notifications and rate archives that secondary press garbled; multiple irreconcilable secondary figures require deep primary-source chasing and inference over gross-vs-net and date-of-estimate distinctions
rationale.tier: FORCED full per Bot 2 mandate regardless of auto-classification; five contested figures with irreconcilable spreads require the contradiction-graph, depth-investigation and full adversarial critic suite
